data.body: Phase 1 of the user assignment. Ensure Hive Flow provider agents support pre-scripted redirection on failures/errors/blocks, microcompaction parity with Claude Code CLI behavior, full autocompaction parity with Codex CLI behavior, native effortless tools, useful tool-error feedback, and auto-recovery from blocks. Use Hive Flow agents for live self-audit, conservative native sub-agent review where needed, and add bats/fast-check/regression coverage before commit/push.
data.title: Audit and harden Hive Flow agent recovery, compaction, and tool-error redirection
